entry.title: [Amazon.ca] BOTSLAB 810SE Solar Doorbell Camera: 2K HDR, 180° View, Solar Charging – $62.39
entry.content:
The BOTSLAB 810SE is a wireless video doorbell camera with 2K HDR video, a 180° field of view, and two-way audio for monitoring your front door and deliveries. AI-powered detection can distinguish people from other movement and send alerts for detected packages, with customizable detection zones to help reduce unwanted notifications.
The included 5W solar panel charges the built-in 5200mAh battery, with the manufacturer claiming up to 365 days of operation under suitable sunlight conditions. The camera has an IP66 weatherproof rating and supports temperatures from -4°F to 122°F. Installation can be done using the included adhesive or screws, without hiring an electrician.
Additional features include Alexa and Google Assistant compatibility, quick-reply messages, and two-way communication through the BOTSLAB app. There is a one-month cloud storage trial, while a microSD card of up to 256GB can be used for local storage without an ongoing subscription. The package also includes an 18-month warranty.
The regular price is $89.99, but the current Amazon promotion brings it down to $62.39 with the 22% promo code and an additional 11% limited-time deal coupon. Enter code 9GKE5DL9 at checkout.
